text:
sam: Heads-up: initiating a small billing roll-forward tweak. Starting 2026-07-01 we'll normalize overage rounding to 1 token granularity (was previously variable by model). This mainly impacts micro-usage customers and frees up a small amount of rounding noise on invoices. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/docs/billing/rounding-update :loudspeaker:

anita: Can you confirm the change only affects displayed invoice math and not metering for quota enforcement?

sam: Correct. Metering and rate limits unchanged. Only the billing aggregation step (invoice rounding) changes to round up to the nearest token once per line item instead of per-chunk. Gives customers simpler bills.

billing-bot: Reminder: change will update `invoice_detail` export column `charged_units` semantics. Update ETL.

support: Need a one-liner for customers. Draft: "We've simplified how small fractional token charges are rounded on invoices to make totals more consistent. This won't affect your usage limits."

sales: Any revenue impact?

sam: Minimal (<0.05% ARR). Finance assessed and approved.

ops: We'll watch for an increase in billing tickets first week after change. Support to escalate recurring cases to billing-ops.

anita: Ok. Please add note that legacy invoices remain unchanged; only future invoices from 7/1.

sam: Added. End thread.
